title: Users will forever lose their accrued rewards if they call `withdrawStake` before calling `claimReward` first
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as this will lead to a monetary loss for users  **Likelihood:** Medium, as even though the front-end will enforce the right sequence of calls, the Gitbook docs falsely claims re-staking will re-gain user's access to their rewards  ## Description  The contract is implemented so that if a user calls `withdrawStake` without first calling `claimReward` for each reward pool then the staker will lose all of his unclaimed rewards forever, they will be locked into the staking contract.
